# Shogun OS

> Shogun OS is a reference architecture for running an entire organization through Hermes Agent. Each department gets a dedicated AI operator with role-specific tools, memory, and autonomy. Built on Hermes Agent + GBrain.

Repo: https://github.com/limcheehow/company-os

## Core entry points

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/AGENTS.md): Start here if you are an AI agent. Install order, file layout, common tasks, trust boundary.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/CLAUDE.md): Claude Code entry point. Orientation, key files, cross-cutting invariants.
- [INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md): 8-phase agent installation protocol.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/README.md): Project overview, architecture diagram, quick start, troubleshooting.

## Architecture

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Three-layer system design (Hermes profiles → GBrain → Slack bots).
- [docs/architecture/OVERVIEW.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/docs/architecture/OVERVIEW.md): Detailed architecture with data flow, scrum architecture, cron architecture, security model.

## Setup & Deployment

- [SETUP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/SETUP.md): 8-phase human-readable setup playbook.
- [docs/tutorials/getting-started.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/docs/tutorials/getting-started.md): From zero to first department agent in 30 minutes.
- [docs/tutorials/add-new-department.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/docs/tutorials/add-new-department.md): How to create a new department agent beyond the 10 defaults.
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/SECURITY.md): Threat model, trust boundaries, secret management.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute, what goes in/out, skill format.

## Profiles & Cron

- [PROFILE_CATALOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/PROFILE_CATALOG.md): All 10 department profiles with personas, sources, skills, domains.
- [CRON_INVENTORY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/CRON_INVENTORY.md): Every cron job across all profiles (54 total).

## Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/install.sh) | Install skills, scripts, templates; gbrain version check; deploy profiles |
| [generate-profile.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/generate-profile.py) | Generate Hermes profile with SOUL.md + config.yaml from template |
| [wire-crons.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/wire-crons.py) | Generate and apply cron jobs per profile type |
| [init-gbrain.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/init-gbrain.sh) | Initialize gbrain with all 11 department sources |
| [verify-install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/verify-install.sh) | Full install verification with MCP connectivity probe |
| [backup-crons.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/backup-crons.py) | Export cron jobs to portable JSON |
| [restore-crons.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limcheehow/company-os/main/scripts/restore-crons.py) | Restore cron jobs from backup |
